faq.question: Q1. What is IIEST, Shibpur Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a departmental promotion recruitment drive conducted by IIEST, Shibpur to fill 5 vacancies for the Junior Assistant post among eligible non-teaching employees.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIEST, Shibpur Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced under advertisement number RDO/903/26.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-in application form is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for IIEST, Shibpur Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: Eligible non-teaching employees working as Office Attendant (SG-II) with at least 2 years of regular service and a Grade Pay of Rs. 2,000/- can apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for IIEST, Shibpur Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive pay in PB-1 (Rs. 5,200 - 20,200/-) with a Grade Pay of Rs. 2,000/-.
